responsibilities_block: Set welding-machine current, voltage, speed, and other parameters according to process sheets.
Fixture workpieces, position tooling, and start and monitor welding processes.
Observe weld formation and promptly identify misalignment, porosity, and other defects.
Clean welding guns, replace wire and consumables, and maintain equipment.
Resolve material jams, arc loss, and other faults, adjusting parameters when necessary.
Record process and inspection data to support quality traceability.
page.work_context_block: Before the shift, review the process sheet and adjust current, voltage, and travel speed to the workpiece specification; any mismatch affects penetration and formation. Clamp workpieces securely, then watch the weld path after startup and stop immediately if the sound changes or spatter looks abnormal. Small batches require frequent setup, while volume production combines machine tending with patrol inspection and continuous recording of parameters and output.
